subject: general
question: The compound interest on a certain sum of money at 21% p.a. for 2 years is Rs. 11,138.40 (interest compounded yearly). The total amount received (in Rs) after 2 years is:
solution:
**Used data:**

Rate = 21% p.a

Time = 2 years

CI = Rs 11,138.40

**Formula used:**

Effective rate for two years = r1 + r2 + r₁ × r₂ over 100

Where “r1” and “r2” are successive rates offered in the two-year period.

A = P + CI

Where A is the Amount and P is the Principal.

**Calculation:**

Effective rate for two years = 21 + 21 + 21 × 21 over 100 = 42 + 4.41 = 46.41%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/663e8129fe25dc35409019815f9619a230d851cf9e1e59b39a4d7df3c350f3ce.png] 

∴ Principal = 11,138.40 × 100 over 46.41 = Rs 24,000

⇒ Amount = 24,000 + 11,138.40 = Rs 35,138.40

∴ **The total amount for the two-year period was Rs 35,138.40.**

1
